note: Chippewa National Forest (Deer River district) campground on a wooded point between Seelye Bay of Cut Foot Sioux Lake and Dry Creek Lake, 20 miles north of Deer River off Highway 46 and 2.5 miles west on Eagle Nest Road (FR 2198). One gravel lane; sites 7, 9, 11, 12 and 13 sit between the lane and the shore under trees. Swimming beach, picnic area, fish-cleaning station, dock and boat ramp; the Cut Foot Sioux National Recreation Trail passes the campground. Rustic; reviewers report sites tight for big rigs. --Claude
